title: President Trump finds himself isolated in DC over his moves to reinstate Jensen Huang as even some of his staunchest allies vow to probe Huang and Nvidia (CNBC)
summary: CNBC: President Trump finds himself isolated in DC over his moves to reinstate Jensen Huang as even some of his staunchest allies vow to probe Huang and Nvidia — President Donald Trump wanted Jensen Huang back at the helm of Nvidia. Now that the chip mogul is reinstated, Trump is cheering alone in Washington.
